item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.

turns.text: Could you make a promo for Northside Gym with a welcoming gym scene rather than hardcore bodybuilding? I want people to feel comfortable about the idea of going to the gym, because I know it can feel a little intimidating at first. I’m probably overthinking how it will come across, but that’s why I’m explaining it all. It should have upbeat music and no voiceover, and what I’m after is a 10-second vertical video. For the last 5 seconds, please keep all these details on screen together: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Make that text big enough to read on a phone.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical promotional video for Northside Gym. Warm, welcoming, approachable neighborhood gym, not hardcore bodybuilding. Bright airy clean gym with natural daylight, friendly adults of varied body types and fitness levels in comfortable modest workout clothes. No intimidating physiques, heavy lifting, aggressive training or dramatic dark lighting. 0–5 seconds: smooth gentle camera move through the space, a friendly staff member smiles and welcomes an adult newcomer, people casually walk on treadmills and do light easy exercise. Authentic relaxed smiles, reassuring mood, comfortable beginner-friendly environment. 5–10 seconds: transition to a stable, carefully composed end card over a softly blurred welcoming gym background with a dark translucent panel. All FOUR exact lines must appear TOGETHER at 5 seconds and remain continuously visible, static and unchanged until the video ends at 10 seconds: 'Northside Gym' / '18 Cedar Road' / 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' / 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'. Set these as four centered separate lines in very large bold clean sans-serif type, white text on dark panel, excellent contrast, generous line spacing, comfortably within mobile-safe margins, readable on a phone. Brand name slightly larger; every detail large and fully legible. Do not stagger, scroll, animate, abbreviate, paraphrase, or remove these lines during the final five seconds. No other text. Audio: upbeat warm light instrumental pop with a cheerful groove throughout, moderate energy, no vocals, no speech and absolutely no voiceover. End cleanly at ten seconds.
